name: Medical Imaging
description: Introduction to radiation physics, physics of different imaging modalities: x-ray radiation, x-ray computed tomography, ultrasonic imaging, magnetic resonance imaging, nuclear imaging, and optical imaging; physics of contrast-aided imaging modalities; applications of different imaging modalities, including advantages and drawbacks of each modality; instrumentation of different imaging modalities; image analysis techniques; emerging imaging modalities.
